description: Defines structures and classes related to User Equipment (UE) context management in a 5G/4G scheduler, including UE cell lookup, UE handle class with methods for managing UE state, configurations, and interactions with logical channels, timing advance, and DRX.

classes.name: ue_cell_lookup
classes.description: Structure for looking up UE cells based on DU cell index or UE-specific cell index.

classes.name: ue
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) handle managing UE-specific state and operations within the scheduler.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication for the UE.

methods.name: find_cell
methods.description: Finds a UE cell by DU cell index.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Fetches a UE cell by serv_cell_index_t.

methods.name: get_pcell
methods.description: Fetches the primary cell (PCell) of the UE.

methods.name: nof_cells
methods.description: Returns the number of cells configured for the UE.

methods.name: is_ca_enabled
methods.description: Checks if Carrier Aggregation (CA) is enabled.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles downlink MAC control element indication.

methods.name: handle_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration request with new UE configuration.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates pending uplink bytes not allocated in UL HARQ.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Retrieves the UE's logical channel repository.
